name: orb_momentum_v29
mechanism: NIFTY's first 30 minutes (09:15-09:45) establishes a broader overnight-reconciliation range than the classic 20-minute ORB — FII desks take an additional 10 minutes to absorb SGX Nifty divergences and macro data released post-open. When VIX is elevated above 15, option market-makers widen quotes and pull back delta-hedging flows that normally dampen ORB breakouts; institutional directional desks face reduced head-on resistance and their TWAP algo must keep buying through the supply ceiling, producing 25-45 spot point continuation legs. The VIX > 15 condition is the critical differentiator: in calm markets (VIX < 15), ORB breakouts are routinely faded by option sellers harvesting gamma; in elevated-VIX sessions, those sellers step back, letting momentum persist long enough to capture at 5-second resolution with a 30-120 second hold.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-minute ORB breakout gated by VIX > 15 regime filter, confirming elevated VIX reduces option-seller fading resistance
